notes: All workshop visuals, fruit and label symbols, loop geometry, ticket generation, autonomous colleague policy, soundless feedback, interaction controls, and independent replay grading are original. No Melting Pot code, maps, sprites, audio, trained policies, or presentation assets are copied. The deterministic colleague schedule required for local animation ships in public browser state; the benchmark policy restricts evaluated agents to visible task UI.
